title: Mauna Kea: The Tallest Mountain
hook: You think Everest is the tallest?
script: You think Everest is the tallest? But what if you measured from the base? Mauna Kea stands over 10,000 metres tall. From base to summit Mauna Kea is more than 1,000 metres taller than Everest. You could stack two Everests on top of each other and still be shorter than Mauna Kea. That's like piling over 100 skyscrapers on top of each other. Mauna Kea is the real tallest mountain, with most of it hidden underwater. Share this with a friend who loves geography! Remember, Mauna Kea is over 10,000 metres tall, that number's worth a screenshot!
